verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack documents AI-generated reply drafts that match the user's own voice and tone. The Graph API draft and reply endpoints are developer building blocks for creating messages, not AI drafting. The single community mention of Copilot in Outlook says nothing about drafting replies or voice matching.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI drafts replies in my own voice and tone — ready to review and send, not generic boilerplate
